newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in london edge up ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in london edge up ahead of holiday.

text.p: Japanese stocks in London were fractionally higher on Wednesday with some weakness in selected hi-tech stocks as dealers adjusted portfolio's ahead of Thursday's holiday in Japan.
London's Nikkei/Ise 50 share index was up just 1.18 points at 1,425.45 by 1330 GMT.

"It has been a little bit busier today ahead of the holiday," one trader said. "There has been quite a bit of position tidying and derivatives related trade," he added. Features included Mitsubishi Electric, which was trading at 1.850 yen in London after its Tokyo close of 1,860.
NEC was another loser, down to 1,257.5 yen in London after finishing at 1,270 in Tokyo.
"Generally, stocks are holding up quite well considering people are not very confident about the (Tokyo) market," the trader said.
Political worries weighed on equities in Japan ahead of Thursday's market holiday. The key 225-share average lost 167.7 points or 0.8 percent to finish at 20,870.83.
"Now we're below the 21,000 level I don't see any upside until the elections are out of the way," he said.
